positive.prompt: Interview me about what I actually want before you build anything
Grill me on the requirements, the ask is fuzzy
Ask me one question at a time until you understand the feature

negative.prompt: Run the full test suite and report failures
Deploy the current build to staging
Stress-test this high-stakes migration plan for hidden failure modes

evals.prompt: I want 'a better admin page'. Interview me before proposing anything.
evals.expected_output: A one-question-at-a-time interview that converges on validated requirements
expectations: Questions are asked one at a time, not in batches
The agent does not propose solutions before understanding the need
The interview surfaces the underlying goal behind the stated ask
The agent distinguishes project facts from assumptions before asking a material question
The question includes an honest tentative guess or concrete options when helpful rather than an intentionally false guess

evals.prompt: The active coordinator already authorized the notifications work and owns the next phase. Read notifications-spec.md. Its user is the assigned task owner; success is one email per opted-in user and logical event; retries must not duplicate delivery; no SMS, push, or history UI. Save the working intent in docs/intent/notifications.md and return the intent evidence to the coordinator. Do not implement code. Routine reversible choices are delegated.
evals.expected_output: A saved intent grounded in the existing spec, with no redundant intake or save-approval pause, returned to the active coordinator
expectations: The existing notifications spec is read before proposing questions
The saved intent includes the actor, observable success, binding constraints and non-goals
Clear delegated authority is accepted without demanding a literal yes or asking permission to save
The agent returns concise intent evidence to the active coordinator rather than recursively restarting routing
No implementation code is written because the current delegated task is intent preparation

evals.prompt: Interview only. I need a personal list of experiments, for myself, by Friday. Success means I can see every running experiment and its current status in one place. No team dashboard, analytics, or automation. Choose reversible details yourself. Restate the intent; stop after that.
evals.expected_output: A concise statement of intent with explicit success and non-goals; no invented clarification requirement or downstream build
expectations: The statement captures personal experiment tracking rather than a team dashboard
Existing answers and delegated choices are accepted without an arbitrary confidence or literal-yes gate
No spec, plan, or implementation is started because the request is explicitly interview-only
